title: Restless Bandits with Individual Penalty Constraints: Near-Optimal Indices and Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2604.04101v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper investigates the Restless Multi-Armed Bandit (RMAB) framework under individual penalty constraints to address resource allocation challenges in dynamic wireless networked environments. Unlike conventional RMAB models, our model allows each user (arm) to have distinct and stringent performance constraints, such as energy limits, activation limits, or age of information minimums, enabling the capture of diverse objectives including fairness and efficiency. To find the optimal resource allocation policy, we propose a new Penalty-Optimal Whittle (POW) index policy. The POW index of an user only depends on the user's transition kernel and penalty constraints, and remains invariable to system-wide features such as the number of users present and the amount of resource available. translated_title: 具有个体惩罚约束的不安分多臂老虎机：近最优指数与深度强化学习
translated_abstract: 本文研究了带有个体惩罚约束的不安分多臂老虎机框架，以解决动态无线网络环境中的资源分配挑战。与传统的RMAB模型不同，我们的模型允许每个用户（臂）拥有不同且严格的性能约束，例如能量限制、激活限制或信息年龄最低要求，从而能够刻画包括公平性和效率在内的多样化目标。为了找到最优的资源分配策略，我们提出了一种新的惩罚最优Whittle（POW）指数策略。某个用户的POW指数仅取决于该用户的转移核和惩罚约束，并且对于系统中用户数量、可用资源量等全局特征保持不变。这使得POW指数可以离线计算，无需在线调整，在计算上具有良好的可操作性。此外，我们从理论上证明了……
tldr: 本文针对动态无线网络中的资源分配问题，提出了带有个体惩罚约束的不安分多臂老虎机模型及惩罚最优Whittle（POW）指数策略，该指数仅依赖单个用户的转移核和惩罚约束、可离线计算且具有近最优性能保证，并可通过深度强化学习实现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Penalty-Optimal Whittle (POW) index policy for restless multi-armed bandits with individual penalty constraints, where each index depends only on a user's transition kernel and penalty constraints, enabling offline computation, near-optimality guarantees, and deep reinforcement learning implementation for resource allocation in dynamic wireless networks.
